_doc: verdict of every def by 'path#qual': closed_world mode, and the nodes that differ in library mode. Reviewed by hand against the sources: methods that satisfy an interface of the stdlib or a library and are called through it, never by name (flag.Value Set, sync.Locker Lock and Unlock, ast.Visitor Visit, hash.Hash and context.Context methods Reset, Deadline, Done, Err), alive with their type; a method no interface asks for (Unused, Spare, Idle) is dead although its type is alive.
